title: Map of Divyadesam Vishnu temples
subject: Geography
caption: Map of South India showing the eight self‑manifested Divyadesam Vishnu temples and the 108 main Vishnu temples, with Srirangam highlighted.
altText: A white‑background map of South India that accurately depicts state borders, coastlines, major rivers, and cities. On the map, 108 Vishnu temples are indicated by small teal temple icons, each with a black label naming the site. The eight self‑manifested (Swayamvyakta) Divyadesam temples are marked with gold‑outlined icons; the Srirangam temple is further highlighted by a larger gold icon and a bold red label. A legend explains the icon colors, and a north arrow and scale bar are present in the lower left corner. The illustration is high‑resolution, photorealistic, and clearly labelled for educational use.
